analysis:
Only base_text excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (base lines 861-1713) were supplied. No patch hunks or head_text were included, so the actual PR delta is not visible and I could not tie any change to a head line. This is a coverage limit, not evidence the change is safe. The file is documentation only (no executable code), so any security impact would come from documented claims drifting from the threat model.

Security-relevant base statements the next pass should check against the head diff:
- Cache and storage (T-041): DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE defaults (~1608-1620), SSD write budget and disk caps (1622-1629), and the model-cache location (1060-1098, 1578-1581). The base states that ambient HF/XDG variables never override the saved path. Any head change must not claim a longer TTL than the 30-minute max or imply TTL/LRU purges detached volumes.
- Report upload (A-008, T-058): `darkbloom report` (1401-1449) uploads App Attest and devicecheck evidence. It states that identifiers and paths are dropped, that `sudo` reads the invoking user's auth_token read-only, and that upload is never automatic.
- Logout and unenroll (A-008, TB-011): 1327-1331 and 1351-1370. Local completion is not confirmation of remote revocation (HTTP 204 only). `--keep-serving` requires macOS 27+ and fresh coordinator approval, with no fallback to cleanup.
- Attestation and worker (TB-011, T-052, T-053): the worker qualification env var is forwarded only when exactly `1` (1659-1663); the doctor/APNs diagnostics claims at 1399 must not overstate trust.
- Fan helper (T-044..T-048): `sudo` is required, helper paths are root-owned, and the lease is 15 s (1298-1317, 1490, 1689).
- Updates (T-034, T-043): hash verification before binary replacement (1239-1240); the watchdog is the same binary.
- Token paths are 0600 files in the install dir (1473-1474).

No findings reported. Integration should verify the head diff against these statements.
